summary: Implemented all 12 plan phases: added cc_session_id as the OTel/events.jsonl join key, split skill-memory into skill-learn/skill-distill, restructured skill-distill around a shared sub-mode skeleton, and landed 5 new/redefined telemetry-sourced sub-modes (revise, meta, review, learn, dream), growing /distill from 7 to 12 sub-modes. Phase 12 validation passed all checks, including an extension-redeploy that found and fixed a stale-deploy defect.
decisions_made: cc_session_id is the only genuinely new seam field; cwd was already fully implemented.
--revise/--meta substantially reuse the prior dream sub-mode's content; --revise/--meta/--learn each get their own log file.
meta-builder-agent's documented extension-detection limitation was encoded honestly, not worked around.
